definition.def: To justify a decision, action, or idea means to show or prove that it is reasonable or necessary.
examples: No argument can justify a war. [VERB noun]
Ministers agreed that this decision was fully justified by economic conditions. [VERB noun]

definition.def: To justify printed text means to adjust the spaces between the words so that each line of type is exactly the same length. [computing]
examples: Click on this icon to align or justify text. [VERB noun]
